cabinHintPick: Each distance runs from your seat to the speaker. Pick a speaker to adjust it.
cabinHintTap: Each distance runs from your seat to the speaker. Tap a speaker to adjust it.
discardDraftConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave them?
dspDeviceHint: Applies once the DEQ is connected
duplicateHint: Start a new profile, or save a preset as your own.
selectProfilePrompt: Pick a car profile in the sidebar to see and edit it.
soundStyleSuffix: · on top of the car profile
startEditingHint: Drag any point to start your own version
zoneHintAir: Cymbals, detail and sense of space.
zoneHintBass: Body and punch of bass lines. Too much turns muddy.
zoneHintLowMids: Warmth. Too much sounds boomy or boxy in a small cabin.
zoneHintMids: Where vocals and most instruments live.
zoneHintPresence: Clarity and attack. Too much gets harsh on long drives.
zoneHintSubBass: Felt more than heard: rumble and the weight of a kick drum.
bridgeNoticeDismissHint: Hides this until the bridge restarts.
audioNotConnected: The unit is not connected, so there is nothing to read.
audioBridgeUnreachable: The Pi does not answer, so there is nothing to read.
audioSourceCarSource: Car audio, with the DEQ's EQ
favoritesHint: Star a preset in the library to keep it here.
activeWaiting: Active · goes on when the DEQ connects
activeOutdated: Active · the DEQ plays an older version
noEqualizerHint: No EQ plays on top of the car profile. Drag a band to start an EQ of your own.
factoryEqualizerHint: Pioneer's own style. Drag a band to make your own copy, which then plays.
wifiIntro: The Pi joins these networks at home. In the car it keeps its own network for your phone.
wifiNoneSaved: The Pi has no saved networks.
wifiForgetConnectedConfirm: The Pi uses {ssid} now. If you forget it, the Pi leaves it, and this page can lose the Pi. Forget {ssid}?
wifiPasswordHint: Leave it empty for an open network.
wifiSaved: Saved. The Pi joins {ssid} when it is in range.
wifiJoinRequested: The Pi tries to join a saved network now. This takes up to a minute.
wifiUnavailable: This machine cannot change its Wi-Fi. Install the Wi-Fi helper on the Pi.
wifiRefused: The DEQ is connected. The Pi changes its network only when the car is off.
wifiInvalid: Check the network name. A password has 8 to 63 characters.
wifiFailed: The Pi did not answer. Try again.
systemUnreachable: The Pi does not answer. This page is the copy that your browser cached.
systemOutdatedHint: The Pi serves a newer build. Reload to get it.
settingsLanguageHint: The language of this app on this device.
updatesIntro: The Pi installs each new release by itself while a Wi-Fi network gives it internet. In the car it has none, so it updates at home.
updatesAutomaticHint: Off: the app only tells you that a new version exists, and you install it with the Update button.
updatesRequested: The Pi checks for a new version now. An update takes a few minutes.
updatesUnsupported: This machine has no release updater. Only the Pi updates itself.
updatesGadgetPending: The USB gadget update waits for a moment with no DEQ session.
accessPointIntro: A phone joins the network {ssid} to reach the Pi without your home Wi-Fi.
accessPointDefaultKey: It still uses the public default password, so anyone nearby who read the guide can join it. Set your own.
accessPointKeyHint: 8 to 63 characters. Your phones need it to join the access point.
accessPointSaved: Saved. The Pi uses the new password from its next start. Then join {ssid} with it.
backupIntro: Save your own profiles, your own EQs and your stars to a file, and add them to another copy of the app. An import adds and never deletes. What is there already is skipped.
backupImported: Added {profiles} profiles and {equalizers} EQs. {skipped} were there already.
backupNotALibrary: This file is not a DEQ Tune library, or it comes from a newer version of the app.
backupFailed: The Pi did not answer. Try again.
phoneModeTitle: How this phone reaches the Pi
phoneModeAutomaticHint: Wi-Fi when the Pi is on the same network, else Bluetooth. Use this one.
phoneModeAccessPointHint: The phone joins the Pi's own network. Only for a car with wired Android Auto.
phoneConnectedWifi: Uses Wi-Fi: the Pi is at {address}
phoneConnectedBluetooth: Uses Bluetooth: the Pi is not on this Wi-Fi network
phonePermissionsMissing: The app needs the Bluetooth and the local network permissions to reach the Pi.
communityIntro: Car profiles and EQs that other people shared. An entry you add goes to your own profiles or EQs. It never replaces one of yours.
communityLoadFailed: The library did not load. It needs internet on this phone or computer.
communityProfileWarning: Someone made this profile for their own car. Start at a low volume, and check the levels before you drive.
communityContribute: Share your own profile or EQ
